from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """One paper from the collection: its title and which other collection papers it cites."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The title of this paper as found in the document")
    references_collection_papers: list[str] = Field(description="List of titles of OTHER provided papers (known from the document summaries) that appear in this paper's reference list")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[Paper]
